build_align_modalities_module: build a PyTorch module to align video features to audio features using Conv1d and gated residual connection
create_align_modalities_with_gate: create an AlignModalities instance with a learnable gate parameter for gated feature alignment
create_align_modalities_without_gate: create an AlignModalities instance without a gate for direct feature transformation
run_align_modalities_forward: run forward pass on AlignModalities to align target features to anchor features with normalization
review_align_modalities_forward: review the AlignModalities forward method to understand gated residual fusion of anchor and target tensors
